message.lordofmysteries.absorption.start: §d[Characteristics] §fYou try to forcefully absorb a mass of freshly raw characteristics...
§4[Sanity Collapse] §cThe remnant sanity failed to stand against the madness. Your loss of control has become irreversible...
§4[Sanity Collapse] §cAlthough the potion was successfully integrated, your mental defense line completely shattered! You lost control due to zero sanity!
message.lordofmysteries.rejection.mortal: §c[Divine Rejection] §4A mortal flesh attempts to steal a high-order position without a proper ritual for %s!
message.lordofmysteries.cross_pathway.mi: §4[Aberration] §eA miracle happened! You managed to forcefully contain a potion from a foreign pathway...
message.lordofmysteries.rejection.beyond: §c[Divine Imbalance] §4You did not perform the proper ritual for Sequence %d! The divinity tore your flesh apart instantly!
message.lordofmysteries.characteristic.s: §e[Attribute Stacking] §fThough excruciating, you endured the divinity overload  (Seq %d).
message.lordofmysteries.madness.whisper: §5You hear incomprehensible murmurs... Consciousness fading away...
message.lordofmysteries.madness.failed: §4Your sanity completely collapsed. You became a victim of loss of control.
message.lordofmysteries.characteristic.d: §d[Conservation] §5The Beyonder Characteristics within your body have precipitated.
message.lordofmysteries.ritual.checking: §d[Ritual Checking] §fYou are attempting to contain the divinity of %s Pathway · Sequence %d. The law is verifying the surrounding environment...
message.lordofmysteries.ritual.failed.bi: §c[Ritual Failed] §4The number of 'spectators' (living entities) around you is only %d/15! Failed to weave a grand drama capable of deceiving the laws, ritual unestablished!
